SELECT E.EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PI.SEXCODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SEX_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, B.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(B.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, B.TRAIN_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) AS IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) AS IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, NVL(GET_DEPT_NAME(EPM.DEPART_MANA_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), EPM.DEPART_MANA_CODE) AS DEPART_MANA_NAME, B.TRAIN_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(E.TEST_SCORE) * 0.6 + (SELECT AVG(S.ALLSCORE) FROM EDU_STUDENT_CHECK S WHERE S.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND S.STU_EMPID = E.EMPID) * 0.4)) AS EVA_RESULT, CASE WHEN M.COST_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(M.TEACHER_COST, 0) + NVL(M.MATERIAL_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FIELD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FOOD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.STAY_COST, 0) + NVL(M.TRAFFIC_COST, 0) + NVL(M.VISA_COST, 0) + NVL(M.OTHER_COST, 0)) END AS ALL_COST, TO_CHAR(R.RESULT_NO) AS RESULT_NO FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE E JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = E.EMPID LEFT JOIN HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI ON PI.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID JOIN EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B ON B.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_COST_MANAGER M ON M.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER EPM ON EPM.PLAN_NO = B.PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R ON R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND R.STU_EMPID = E.EMPID WHERE E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(B.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND B.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND B.IMPLE_END_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') + 1
AND UPPER(B.TRAIN_CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
ORDER BY B.COURSE_NAME_CODE, B.PERIOD_TIME, E.EMPID

SELECT H.EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PI.SEXCODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SEX_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, T.EDU_CLASS AS COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(T.EDU_TIMES) AS PERIOD_TIME, NULL AS TRAIN_CONTENT, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(T.EDU_TIME_LENGTH) >= 8 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(T.EDU_TIME_LENGTH) / 8) ELSE TO_CHAR(T.EDU_TIME_LENGTH) END AS IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(T.EDU_TIME_LENGTH) >= 8 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T.EDU_BEGIN_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T.EDU_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, NULL AS DEPART_MANA_NAME, T.EDU_LOCATION AS TRAIN_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(T.PASS_SCORE) AS EVA_RESULT, TO_CHAR(NVL(T.EDU_COST, 0)) AS ALL_COST, NULL AS RESULT_NO FROM EDU_TRAIN_BASIC_HISTORY T JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = T.PERSON_ID LEFT JOIN HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI ON PI.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID WHERE H.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(T.EDU_CLASS) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND TO_DATE(T.EDU_BEGIN_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND TO_DATE(T.EDU_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY T.EDU_CLASS, T.EDU_TIMES, H.EMPID
